rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly on the design: the known balanced batch enters as a covariate in ~ batch + condition with control set as an explicit reference level, counts are never adjusted before the model (removeBatchEffect is confined to visualization), and DESeq2 Wald plus an edgeR QL cross-check are appropriate for 6 vs 6. QC is concrete and dataset-specific: blind VST, PCA colored separately by batch and by condition, sample-distance heatmap annotated by both factors, library sizes, and an explicit flag-not-drop outlier policy. Statistics are handled correctly: internal median-of-ratios/TMM normalization, a minimal filter of >=10 counts in >=6 samples justified by the smallest group size (a touch conservative but defensible), BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, apeglm shrinkage for reported effects, p-value histogram and Cook's/NA accounting. Enrichment is well specified with the full ranked list on the Wald statistic, named and versioned collections, a 15-500 size window, and a conditional ORA restricted to the tested-gene universe, though it is somewhat more than the question strictly requires. Reporting names methods, versions, design, thresholds, tested and significant gene counts, and the relevant caveats.
